description: Watermark plus per-topic turn references for the chat topic bucketer.

last_active.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the newest turn in this topic.

summary.description: 1-2 sentences: what this thread is about and where it stands.

title.description: Short human-readable title, 6 words or fewer.

assistant_excerpt.description: Assistant's reply, quoted or closely paraphrased, 300 chars or fewer.

seq.description: Highest message seq within the turn.

user_excerpt.description: User's message, quoted or closely paraphrased, 200 chars or fewer.

main_chat_id.description: UUID of the watched chat (the main chat).

main_chat_seq.description: Highest message seq processed so far; the watcher only classifies newer turns.

title: Chat topic index
